reviews.text: I’d give no stars if I could. They refused to help a found dog in need. He was bleeding and needed help and the person who found him was turned away. Great job!!!!!

Hi, I’m Latina. I am so grateful for the wonderful people who helped my baby; I adopted him, and he needed help with his ear due to a severe infection and inflammation. For just $106, he came home pain-free and with a 15-day treatment plan. God bless you all. Thank you for everything.

We have taken our dog Max here since day one and they are just the absolute best, but that's not why I wanted to leave this review. Our bearded dragon, Ringo, who we've had for a little over 15 years passed away this week and we were looking in to where we can have him cremated. Unfortunately, the place we had initially found, a place that only specializes in pet funeral services, was asking for a price that was way above our budget, so, we took a shot and spoke to the wonderful people at the Animal Clinic of Bay Ridge. Now, it must be said, they do not work with reptiles, (I believe only dogs and cats) but, they said that because we have been with them for so long, they will take our Ringo and have him cremated for us! As if that wasn't nice enough, they charged us an extremely reasonable price, about 60% less than what the other place wanted to charge! Thank you from the bottom of our grieving hearts! The Animal Clinic of Bay Ridge has made this difficult time so much easier!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

About two weeks ago, our 8-year-old cat Luna suffered an incident with her left paw. We initially took her to another clinic here in Bay Ridge where we had been going for the last 6 years, but unfortunately the examination done there was not enough to properly understand what was happening.

Then my boss mentioned the Animal Clinic of Bay Ridge and recommended Kim, who by coincidence is also someone I know personally. Kim was extremely kind and professional from the very beginning, helping me through text messages to prepare everything for today’s visit on Memorial Day, May 25th. She was there to welcome us at the clinic even though she was about to leave for a trip.

The entire team at Animal Clinic of Bay Ridge was very attentive and caring with Luna. They carefully explained the next steps, and now we are waiting to see if the medication helps over the next 7 days. Thankfully Luna is already walking better. If there are no further improvements, we will return for X-rays to confirm whether there is any fracture.

My wife and I are truly grateful for the care, professionalism, and kindness shown to Luna during this stressful moment for our family. Thank you so much to Kim and the whole team.

Pulled up today to get Princess Zori her yearly vacs. The wait was longer than usual, but a fur baby passed away and so we show empathy and grace to other pet parents. The visit was amazing as always with Dr. Ibrahim. Zori has been coming here since she was 3 months old and she is now 10 years old. Staff is always respectful, friendly, and professional. Highly recommend for all pet parents !
have been a proud client for almost ten years!!! all animal clinics should be this affordable and honest

I’m incredibly grateful for Dr. Ibrahim and the entire team at Animal Clinic of Bay Ridge.

Dr. Ibrahim is very caring, knowledgeable, and always assertive with treatment plans, which gives me a lot of peace of mind as a dog mom. You can truly tell she has a good heart and genuinely cares about her patients. Bruno has been under her care for years, and I always feel supported and listened to.

The veterinary assistants, front desk staff, and everyone at the clinic are incredibly kind, patient, and welcoming. Every visit feels personal, and they always treat Bruno with so much love and compassion.

I travel internationally with Bruno often, and having a veterinary team I fully trust for his care, vaccines, paperwork, and overall well-being means absolutely everything to me. Thank you all for always taking such amazing care of Brunito.
